name: Halo: Project Chozo
summary:
A crossover mod for Halo Combat Evolved on MCC with Metroid Prime elements!

Relive the Campaign of Halo as the infamous bounty hunter Samus Aran! With a small but powerful array of weaponry like the Power Beam, Super Missile and Plasma Beam, fight the Covenant Armada and waves of Flood Metroid Prime style!

All enemies and vehicles have weaknesses and resistances to certain weapons, plus rebalanced difficulty, a new health system, improved UNSC AI, and more!

As well as a secret on the final level...

Will Samus Aran be able to claim her most ambitious bounty yet?
